name: user-config
body: The user config: kalide's per-user settings file under the operating system's user config directory — a flat key-to-string-value map. It is shared by every deck and every working directory; kalide creates or updates it on `kalide config set`, reads it on `kalide config get|list` and when resolving the default template library for `kalide init`. Its first defined key is `default-template-library` (domain.value.default-template-library); other keys are free-form. Local filesystem only.
